text: ポケモンは　タイプに　よって　とくいな　タイプ　にがてな　タイプが　いるなり

structure.jp: とくいな　タイプ　にがてな　タイプが
structure.en: types they are good against, types they are weak against

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing says the result changes from one such thing to another. タイプに　よって = 'depending on type'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: なり is an old-fashioned way of saying だ, 'it is so', used here as this character's quirky way of ending sentences. いるなり = 'there are'.
